hero.headline: Your data has a home now.
hero.sub: One lakehouse with dashboards built in. Bring every source in, keep it in open tables, and ask for answers in plain language.

sources.headline: Everything flows in.
sources.sub: Databases, files, streams and APIs land in one place, on a schedule or as they change.
sources.caption: Live change capture for PostgreSQL. File upload straight from the console.

bronze.title: Raw, kept as it came.
bronze.body: Every source lands untouched in open Apache Iceberg tables, so nothing is lost and nothing is locked in.

silver.title: Cleaned and joined.
silver.body: Pipelines with schedules, dependencies, retries and version history clean the raw data into tables you can trust.

gold.title: Ready for answers.
gold.body: Curated tables built for the questions your business asks, and published as open tables when you switch it on.

assistant.headline: Ask, don't dig.
assistant.sub: The assistant works with the same tools as the console. It answers questions, builds charts and dashboards, and runs pipelines. Anything risky waits for a person to approve it.
assistant.caption: Illustration
assistant.userOne: Which region had the most visitors last quarter?
assistant.answerOne: Region North had the most visitors last quarter.
assistant.srDescription: An illustration of the assistant. A person asks which region had the most visitors last quarter and the assistant answers with a small bar chart. The person then asks to pause the nightly sales pipeline, and the assistant shows a card that waits for a person to approve or decline the change. The region names and numbers are illustrative.

dashboards.headline: Answers come back up as dashboards.
dashboards.sub: About two dozen chart types, maps included. Filter, drill down, share by link, embed in your own site, and get an alert when a number crosses a line.
dashboards.caption: Illustrations, not customer data.

governance.headline: Guarded by default.
governance.sub: Roles decide who sees what. Sensitive columns are classified and masked for everyone who should not see them, and lineage shows which tables each table is built from.
governance.tableCaption: Five fictional customers. As an analyst the name and email columns are masked; as an admin they are shown in full.

facts.label: Proof
facts.text: Masking proven end to end in an acceptance gate

facts.label: Audit
facts.text: Assistant actions logged; risky ones wait for approval

facts.label: Lineage
facts.text: Lineage from raw table to curated table

cards.title: Open source.
cards.body: AGPL-3.0. Read every line, run it yourself.

cards.title: Open tables.
cards.body: Raw data in Apache Iceberg. Any engine that reads Iceberg can read it.

cards.title: Your servers or ours.
cards.body: Install it on your own infrastructure, or talk to us about running it for you.

final.headline: Come on in. The data's fine.
